House Classics · Comedy

The General (1926)

A Civil War train chase staged with real locomotives and deadpan perfection — regularly named the greatest silent comedy.

Directed by Buster Keaton & Clyde Bruckman · Comedy · Silent
Content rating: Family-safe · Original aspect 1.33:1
House mark: Aimée’s pick ✦
